title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4CITY - KeyPerformanceIndicatorAssessment
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/KeyPerformanceIndicatorAssessment. The assessment of a KPI calculated by a given agent at a given time (e.g. '70% road congestion on road segment 50 at 13:30 on 2026-05-20'), as opposed to the general KPI definition held by the related KeyPerformanceIndicator entity. Note: saref4city.ttl declares `s4city:refersToFeature rdfs:domain s4city:KeyPerformanceIndicatorAssessment ; rdfs:range geo:Feature`, so `refersToFeature` is included here even though it is omitted from Table 4 of ETSI TS 103 410-4 clause 4.2.7 (the .ttl was treated as authoritative for this discrepancy).

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'KeyPerformanceIndicatorAssessment'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

hasName.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/hasName'. Name of the KPI assessment.

hasDescription.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/hasDescription'. Natural-language description of the KPI assessment.

hasValue.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/core/hasValue' (reused from SAREF core). The value of the KPI assessment (exactly one, per the ontology's cardinality restriction), e.g. '70' for a 70% congestion value.

hasCreationDate.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/hasCreationDate'. Domain creation date of this KPI assessment (distinct from the generic record-level `dateCreated`).

hasExpirationDate.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/hasExpirationDate'. Expiration date of this KPI assessment.

hasLastUpdateDate.description: Property. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/hasLastUpdateDate'. Last update date of this KPI assessment (distinct from the generic record-level `dateModified`).

isMeasuredIn.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/core/isMeasuredIn' (reused from SAREF core). The saref:UnitOfMeasure the KPI assessment's value is expressed in.

assesses.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/assesses'. The saref:FeatureOfInterest this KPI assessment assesses.

isAssessedBy.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/isAssessedBy'. The Agent that performed this KPI assessment.

isDerivedFrom.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/isDerivedFrom'. The saref:Observation(s) aggregated to calculate this KPI assessment's value.

quantifiesKPI.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/quantifiesKPI'. The general KeyPerformanceIndicator this assessment quantifies.

refersToTime.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/refersToTime'. The time:TemporalEntity (instant or interval, from the W3C Time ontology) this assessment refers to.

refersToFeature.description: Relationship. Model:'https://saref.etsi.org/saref4city/refersToFeature'. The geo:Feature (geographical location) this KPI assessment refers to.
